paragraphs: He is mentioned in Niddah 55b, saying: “What is Rav’s reason?”[^1]

notes.text: The heading abbreviates the title; the stored William Davidson Edition at Niddah 55b explicitly has Rav Chiyya bar Gurya asking What is Rav's reason? This supports the root correction from Rabbi to Rav for this occurrence. The body also spells out רב in Rav's reason; no title is added to Gurya.
